title: Jennifer T NDE 4102
content: I am looking at myself lying in a hospital bed. I am feeling strange, almost dreamlike, but in awe of seeing myself. Something takes hold of my left hand and I turn around, to my right. I am looking at this Being of Light and feel calm and at peace. The Being of Light takes hold of my right hand and releases my left while communicating with me that everything will be all right. The communication is not with spoken words but I just know this. I see a small light, which seems so far away. During this time, I am feeling that this Being of Light is both male and female. I describe it as being calming and protective like a woman yet strong like a male. The Being of Light has no facial features and the light it emits is very soothing. In a blink of an eye, I am standing in a non-defined area with my Being of Light standing behind me and to my left with four other Beings of Light scattered to my right. I am looking at a book, a HUGE book, on an equally large table. A man appears, I know this because of his long brown hair and beard. He is wearing a white glowing robe. He flips through the book, looks at me and asks me with spoken words if I want to stay or go back. I am seeing my mother and infant sister, not in pictures but in my mind and then I wake. The first thing I see is the green tile wall in my hospital room and I start screaming. I remember people rushing in around me and that was that. I also must add that I had been in a coma for one week and my memory from the age of eight and earlier had been erased.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt "strange, almost dreamlike," and "in awe" while seeing herself.

arrival.other_being_detail: A "Being of Light" held her hand(s), communicated reassurance; later there were "four other Beings of Light" to her right. A man with "long brown hair and beard" in a "white glowing robe" appeared and spoke to her.

environment.environment_other_detail: She was in a "non-defined area" with a "HUGE book" on an "equally large table."

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: A large book on a table; a man in a glowing white robe asked if she wanted to stay or go back; she saw her mother and infant sister "in my mind" before waking.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE and immediate encounter with a Being of Light holding her hand; no tunnel described; then sudden arrival in a non-defined area with multiple Beings of Light and a book; then a spoken question about staying vs returning; then waking in the hospital room.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The Being of Light was perceived as both male and female; presence of a "HUGE book" on a large table; she reports being in a coma for one week and that her memory from age eight and earlier had been erased.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "I am looking at myself lying in a hospital bed."; "I am looking at this Being of Light and feel calm and at peace."; "The communication is not with spoken words but I just know this."; "In a blink of an eye, I am standing in a non-defined area..."; "He flips through the book... and asks me with spoken words if I want to stay or go back."
